kitDescription: Rapunzel: Sanctuary is a Fire rocket-launcher Supporter who bursts in stage II. Every full-charge shot she fires heals the whole team for 3.9% of her max HP and launches an extra hit worth 220.7% of her ATK at the enemy nearest her crosshair. Whenever any Full Burst begins, she buffs herself — and any allies standing in an 'Into the Fray' stance, a state her own kit never grants but some other Pilgrims carry — with Attack Damage ▲27.45% and a flat ATK boost equal to 29.17% of her own ATK, both for 10 seconds. Her burst skill normally gives the whole team ATK equal to 34.84% of her ATK for 10 seconds; if three or more allies are down it instead revives them once per battle with big one-time ATK/DEF buffs, at the permanent cost of +40 seconds on her burst cooldown. Holding a full charge for at least a second (something auto play never does) also projects a shared shield and a team DEF blessing, and she is permanently immune to anything that speeds up or slows down her charge.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA survives. All 12 kit lines are FAITHFUL (6) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (6, each verbatim in unmodeled with a reasoned reachability/primitive argument and a ⚑ recipe), and the S2d matrix shows arm-1 RED (no override) plus every named nearest-wrong counterfactual discriminated in-file, so discrimination holds. The S5 convergence run is formally RED, but all three failures attribute to the blind side: S2-a/S2-b stem from S5/S6 proxying the 'Full Charge maintained ≥1s' hold trigger onto fullCharge — the exact nearest-wrong both independent S2b reviewers pre-registered, and the opposite of three precedent overrides — and the S2-d noFb arm patches an engine-inert field (a blind test defect; the premise it probes is separately pinned GREEN by the driver's fbMajorApplied assertion). The blind re-derivations otherwise converge byte-identically on every damage-bearing block, including the kit's two hard calls (burstCast vs fullBurstEnter identity, proven with a cast-frame-precedes-FB pin plus a two-B2 fixture; the casterAtkPct flat basis). The engine change (alliesInStatus target) was regression-byte-identical and separately code-reviewed/pinned, so no NO-GO(engine-core) concern. Same-model residuals for the owner to spot-check: (1) the ⚑1 ecosystem dependency — no shipped override yet emits an 'Into the Fray: …' selfStatus, so both FB-entry grants are self-only in every current comp and her graded team-support value is understated until marian-queen/scarlet-goddeath emit the status (the proposed cross-override edit is correctly left to the orchestrator); (2) all magnitudes are SL10 kit literals with no real-fight recording yet — a single popup read of the 220.7% rider inside vs outside FB would independently confirm the FB-by-timing default; (3) the shield line's tandem channel means her value next to a shielded-trigger consumer is genuinely unmodeled, per the documented caveat, and a manual-play hold-charge measurement is the recorded recipe.
